title: Separate buy confidence from avoid confidence
description: Late-day monitor confidence rose above 0.75 for QCOM, GM, and HOOD even though all were watch/avoid decisions. Confidence should be directional and action-specific so high confidence to avoid cannot be misread as high confidence in the original long thesis.
expected_impact: Prevents stale bullish candidates from appearing stronger after they fail gates and improves next-day calibration.

title: Auto-downgrade failed buy ranges after stop-reference breach
description: QCOM moved from inside/near the buy range to below the planned stop reference, but remained in the same watch loop. A candidate that trades below its planned stop before entry should require a fresh thesis and a new setup before it can be considered again.
expected_impact: Reduces temptation to bottom-fish failed catalyst gaps and keeps the system from recycling invalidated entries.

title: Add FDA and company-specific event mover scan
description: The system missed Moderna's large FDA-briefing-document move while watching weaker headline setups. The morning screen should include FDA calendars, briefing documents, and same-day regulatory catalysts for liquid healthcare names.
expected_impact: Broadens opportunity capture beyond AI and macro-relief themes, especially on mixed index days where healthcare leads.

title: Require breadth confirmation for risk-on labels
description: The morning regime was risk_on because oil and VIX improved, but the close was mixed with Nasdaq weakness. Regime classification should require breadth, QQQ/SPY behavior, and sector participation before enabling growth-stock buys.
expected_impact: Avoids overallocating to crowded growth names during relief rallies that rotate into Dow cyclicals or defensives.

title: Track missed mover reason codes
description: Missed opportunities came from regulatory catalysts, newly public mega-cap momentum, and overlooked semiconductor packaging news. Store missed-mover reason codes so screening gaps can be measured over multiple reflections.
expected_impact: Turns anecdotal missed opportunities into a prioritized data-source backlog.

title: Distinguish missing VWAP from failed VWAP
description: WDC was skipped because VWAP support was not shown, yet it reclaimed the plan and closed far above target. The monitor should mark unavailable VWAP/relative-strength evidence as unknown and apply alternate checks such as close-near-high, sector leadership, and trigger reclaim.
expected_impact: Would have kept WDC eligible after reclaim instead of treating absent confirmation as a blocker.

title: Add late-day earnings-entry cutoff
description: AVAV was bought minutes before its scheduled after-close earnings call. Event setups should require an explicit hold-through-earnings flag or block new entries in the final 30 minutes before a binary report.
expected_impact: Prevents technically fair entries from becoming unmanaged overnight event bets.

title: Map headline themes to adjacent liquid winners
description: The system saw SpaceX and cable headlines through CHTR/CMCSA but missed ASTS and RKLB, the cleaner satellite/aerospace momentum winners. Theme extraction should expand watch candidates to adjacent liquid tickers with confirmed volume.
expected_impact: Improves capture of real top movers when the original headline names are extended or messy.

title: Add afternoon regime escalation check
description: The morning neutral call was prudent, but QQQ and SPY strengthened materially while VIX fell. The monitor should reclassify neutral-to-risk-on when index gains, VIX compression, and leader close-near-high behavior align, while still respecting symbol gates.
expected_impact: Allows the system to participate in confirmed afternoon trend days without abandoning entry discipline.
